_meta.ptally/summary: Lists client journeys: the quotes saved under one client reference, shown as one case with its latest price, whether it is valid or sold, and when it started and last changed.
_meta.swallow/summary: Lists client journeys: the quotes saved under one client reference, shown as one case with its latest price, whether it is valid or sold, and when it started and last changed.

description: List client journeys stored on this self-host instance. A journey is every quote saved with the same `client_ref` (the caller's own case id, e.g. a state-machine or application id); each quote is a snapshot of the case at that point. One row per client_ref, most recently active first. Each row is the journey's latest quote in the get_quotes shape (`result`, `valid`, `amended_result`, `amended_valid`, `sold`, …) plus `start_date` and `end_date` (its first and last quote's created_at), `quote_count`, `quotes` (`[{ quote_reference, created_at }]`, oldest first) and `journey_url` (the dashboard's view of it). Quotes saved without a client_ref belong to no journey. Filter by `project_reference` (only that project's quotes count), `since` (ISO date; journeys with a quote since then) or `search` (text match on client_ref). Paged with `limit` (default 25, max 100) and `offset`; `has_more` says whether another page exists. Returns `{ count, limit, offset, has_more, journeys: [...], next_steps }`. Call get_journey for one journey's quotes in full.

offset.description: Optional. Rows to skip, for paging.

project_reference.description: Optional. Only this project's quotes (get_projects lists them).

search.description: Optional. Text to match in the client_ref.

since.description: Optional. ISO date or date-time; only journeys with a quote at or after it.

name: get_journeys
title: List client journeys
